Any.description:
`Any` contains an arbitrary serialized message along with a
URL that describes the type of the serialized message

@type.description: A URL/resource name that uniquely identifies the type of the serialized message.

agraphcommoncommonreferencesportfolioPor.description:
Reference to a portfolio. This includes both the portfolio ID and the portfolio ticker. 
For read operations, both fields are returned. 
For write operations, only one of the two is required. 
If both are provided, the portfolio ID takes precedence over the portfolio ticker.

googlerpcStatus.description:
The `Status` type defines a logical error model that is suitable for
different programming environments, including REST APIs and RPC APIs. It is
used by [gRPC](https://github.com/grpc). Each `Status` message contains
three pieces of data: error code, error message, and error details.

You can find out more about this error model and how to work with it in the
[API Design Guide](https://cloud.google.com/apis/design/errors).

code.description: The status code, which should be an enum value of [google.rpc.Code][google.rpc.Code].

details.description:
A list of messages that carry the error details.  There is a common set of
message types for APIs to use.

message.description:
A developer-facing error message, which should be in English. Any
user-facing error message should be localized and sent in the
[google.rpc.Status.details][google.rpc.Status.details] field, or localized by the client.

If the strategy has a parent, the name must be prefixed with the parent name, separated by a colon.
Example: "US : BONDS" (where "US" is the parent strategy).

tradev2FilterQuery.description: Captures various criteria and options for filtering trades.

options.description:
Options for loading additional trade data to enrich the response.
"FILTER_QUERY_OPTION_UNSPECIFIED" -  Default value. Indicates that no additional filtering options are applied. When specified, this option does not modify the API response.
"FILTER_QUERY_OPTION_LOAD_TRADE_RELATIONSHIP": Include trade relationship metadata (such as links to related trades) for each trade in the response.
"FILTER_QUERY_OPTION_LOAD_EXTERNAL_TRADE_REFERENCE": Include external trade references (for example, Trade IDs from external systems or platforms).
"FILTER_QUERY_OPTION_LOAD_TRADE_COLLATERAL": Include collateral-related details associated with the trade.
"FILTER_QUERY_OPTION_LOAD_TRADE_FX_LEGS": Include FX leg details (such as spot/forward components for FX trades) for each trade in the response.

tradev2FilterTradesRequest.description: It represents a request to filter trades.

expands.description:
Specifies which related reference data should be included in the response.
Currently, only asset-related information can be expanded. By default, the response includes just the asset ID.
To get more detailed asset information, use "asset.summary" to include a summary with additional asset details.
For full usage guidance, refer to the Trade API release notes.

pageSize.description: The maximum number of trades to return. The service may return fewer than this value. If unspecified or 0, the default value will be applied.

pageToken.description:
A page token, received from a previous 'filterTrades' call. Provide this to retrieve the subsequent page.
When paginating, all other parameters provided to 'filterTrades' must match the call that provided the page token.

tradev2FilterTradesResponse.description: Returns a paginated list of block trades that satisfy the specified filter criteria, enriched based on any requested options and expands. It also carries a next_page_token for retrieving additional results and a status field summarizing processing progress and any partial failures.

blockTrades.description:
Returns a list of block trades matching the filtering criteria.
A block trade represents a single execution with shared block‑level attributes and includes one or more underlying allocation trades.

nextPageToken.description: A token to retrieve the next page of results in subsequent request.

v2CancelTradeConfig.description: Defines how trade cancellations are processed.

cancelEntireBlock.description:
When set to True, the entire trade block will be cancelled.
When set to False, the API will cancel only the specified trades and will not cancel the rest of the allocations in the same block.

suppressExternalNotification.description:
When set to True, trade notifications to external parties or external systems will be suppressed. 
When set to False, trade notifications to external parties or external systems will be sent.

v2FilterQueryOption.description:
Defines various filtering options.

 - FILTER_QUERY_OPTION_UNSPECIFIED: Default value. Indicates that no additional filtering options are applied. When specified, this option does not modify the API response.
 - FILTER_QUERY_OPTION_LOAD_TRADE_RELATIONSHIP: Option to load trade relationships.
 - FILTER_QUERY_OPTION_LOAD_EXTERNAL_TRADE_REFERENCE: Option to load external references.
 - FILTER_QUERY_OPTION_LOAD_TRADE_COLLATERAL: Option to load trade collateral.
 - FILTER_QUERY_OPTION_LOAD_TRADE_FX_LEGS: Option to load trade fx legs.
 - FILTER_QUERY_OPTION_LOAD_ORIGINAL_ORDER_REFERENCE: Option to load original order reference including Portfolio Manager's and external order identifiers.

overrideCharges.description: Indicates whether charges should be overridden. When true, existing charges on the trade are overwritten; when false, existing charges remain unchanged.

overrideRelationships.title: Indicates whether existing trade relationships should be overridden. When true, trade relationships are updated; when false, existing relationships remain unchanged

updateEntireBlock.description: Indicates whether the entire block of trades should be updated. When true, all trades in the block are updated; when false, the update applies only to the specified allocation-level trade.

v2RetrieveQuery.description: Defines the criteria to retrieve specific trades, such as trade keys, external trade references, or order identifiers.

options.description:
Options for loading additional trade data such as complete block trade.
"RETRIEVE_QUERY_OPTION_UNSPECIFIED" -  Default value. Indicates that no additional filtering options are applied. When specified, this option does not modify the API response.
"RETRIEVE_QUERY_OPTION_LOAD_COMPLETE_BLOCK" - Returns the complete block trade — including all allocations — instead of only the specific allocation(s) requested.

v2RetrieveQueryCriteria.description: Criteria used to retrieve trades. Only one type of criterion (e.g., trade keys, external trade keys, order keys) may be provided in a single request.

externTradeKeys.description: A list of external trade key criteria.

tradeKeys.description: A list of trade key criteria.

v2RetrieveQueryOption.description:
Defines various retrieve options.

 - RETRIEVE_QUERY_OPTION_UNSPECIFIED: Default value. Indicates that no additional filtering options are applied. When specified, this option does not modify the API response.
 - RETRIEVE_QUERY_OPTION_LOAD_COMPLETE_BLOCK: Option to load complete block trade.
 - RETRIEVE_QUERY_OPTION_LOAD_ORIGINAL_ORDER_REFERENCE: Option to load original order reference including Portfolio Manager's and external order identifiers.

transactionTypes.description: A list of trade transaction types from the decode ‘TRANTYPES’.

v2TradeKey.description: TradeKey represents the uniquely identified keys of trade.

touchCount.description: Touch count of the trade - if version and touch count are absent, we fetch the latest trade.

version.description: Version of the trade - if version and touch count are absent, we fetch the latest trade.

v2TradeSnippet.description: TradeSnippet represents a summary of a Trade.

externalTradeReferences.description: External trade references associated with this trade.

orderId.description: Order ID associated with this trade.
